mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS run_id,r.read_count,r.task_id FROM int_base_sync_run r JOIN int_base_sync_task t ON t.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND t.id=r.task_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND r.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND t.task_code='BASE_P16' AND r.task_code='BASE_P16' AND t.deleted=FALSE AND r.deleted=FALSE AND r.preview=FALSE AND r.status='COMPLETED' ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM int_base_sync_binding b JOIN int_base_sync_task t ON t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.id=b.task_id WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND t.task_code='BASE_P16' AND t.deleted=FALSE AND b.task_id=#{query.taskId} AND b.deleted=FALSE AND b.last_run_id=#{query.publicationId} AND b.object_key='PROJECT_MASTER'

SELECT b.source_key,p.id AS project_id,p.project_type,p.project_code AS original_project_code,p.project_code,b.fingerprint FROM int_base_sync_task t STRAIGHT_JOIN int_base_sync_binding b FORCE INDEX (uk_int_base_sync_binding_source) ON t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.id=b.task_id STRAIGHT_JOIN proj_project p ON p.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND p.id=b.target_id WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND t.task_code='BASE_P16' AND t.deleted=FALSE AND b.task_id=#{query.taskId} AND b.deleted=FALSE AND p.deleted=FALSE AND b.last_run_id=#{query.publicationId} AND b.object_key='PROJECT_ALIAS' AND b.source_key > #{query.afterKey} ORDER BY b.source_key LIMIT 500
